title: Dark glass tab bar with raised glowing center action and green current-tab marker (crypto/finance)

observed.layout: Bottom navigation inside a phone frame with five tabs: Home, Wallet, Exchange, Markets, Profile. The center 'Exchange' tab is a raised blue circle set into a smooth notch in the bar's top edge, with a blue glow. The current tab 'Markets' has a white icon and label and a short glowing green bar at the bottom edge. Above the bar, content appears as grey skeleton placeholders (circular avatars and text bars).
observed.hierarchy: Two emphasis systems at once: raised blue circle (primary action) and green tick under Markets (current location).
observed.typography: Rounded geometric sans, small labels; white active, grey inactive. Typeface unconfirmed.
observed.iconography: Consistent outline icons; the Markets icon is a shopping cart, an unusual metaphor for 'Markets'.
observed.materials: Dark frosted glass with visible film-grain noise, thin light edge, blue and green glows.
observed.background: Dark ribbon-like texture behind the phone.

interpretation.aesthetic: Dark fintech/crypto. Glow color carries meaning (blue = act, green = you are here).
implementation_notes: Notch: SVG path or mask with smooth bezier edges around the raised circle.
Glow: blurred pseudo-element or box-shadow in the accent color.
Grain: noise overlay (SVG feTurbulence or tiled PNG).
Skeleton placeholders imply a loading state in the screen above.

concept_work.essence: Separate 'what can I do' (raised center action) from 'where am I' (glowing marker) using different shapes and colors.
what_makes_it_work: Distinct visual language for action vs location.
Texture and glow give depth on an otherwise flat dark UI.
gaps_to_make_it_work: Inactive labels sit near 4:1 and the Exchange label near 3.3:1.
The green marker sits at the bar's bottom edge and may collide with the system home indicator.
Two glowing emphases can compete when both are on screen.

pattern.name: Raised center action tab plus separate current-tab marker
use_when: Mobile app with 4-5 destinations and one dominant transactional action
avoid_when: The center action is not the main task
Low-contrast environments where labels must stay readable
must_preserve: Distinct treatment for action vs current location
Notch that follows the raised element
adaptation_examples: Ticketing app: raised center 'Scan' button, current tab shown by underline instead of a glow.
Light theme: replace glows with soft shadows, keep the notch.

lessons: Use different visual channels (shape vs color/glow) for action and location.
Check metaphors: an icon should match the label's meaning.

measured.palette_method: Median-cut quantization of the supplied image plus saturated-pixel hue medians. Approximate (JPEG). Items marked 'approx' were judged by eye.
palette: blue-slate tint near the center button (~5%)
measured.color_roles: Near-black neutral surface; blue = primary action; green = current location; white = active text; mid-grey = inactive.
measured.contrast_method: Estimated from the compressed image: background = dominant color in the measured box, foreground = mean of the most distant ~4% of pixels, ratio = WCAG relative-luminance contrast. Thin or anti-aliased text biases toward lower ratios; values within 0.3 of a threshold (3.0 or 4.5) are marked near_threshold and should be verified in the source file.

purpose.evidence: Five clearly named tabs and one dominant action fit a trading/wallet app.

visual.evidence: Depth from glow, grain and notch; clear focal point on the center button.

discipline.evidence: Raised-center pattern is established, but the cart icon for 'Markets' and two competing emphases weaken correctness.

usability.evidence: Active tab shown; pressed/disabled/badge states and Exchange-vs-Markets distinction are not shown.

consistency.evidence: Uniform outline icons and label style; center button intentionally different.

originality.evidence: Grain texture plus glow as semantic color goes beyond the default dark tab bar.

evidence: primary text min 3.26:1; secondary text min n/a:1; icon min 4.43:1; non-color state cue: True.
accessibility.basis: computed from measured contrast + cue flag (scope: contrast and non-color cues only; touch targets, motion, screen-reader support are not assessable from a static image)

evaluation.readiness_key: A = ship with minor adjustments (>=80, no critical failure); B = needs specific fixes (60-79); C = rethink (<60)
evaluation.scope: Scored as presented in a static image. States, motion and behavior that are not shown are not scored as present.
